description: Model to Full-Scale Validation of Peak Pressure Mechanisms in Buildings that Cause Cladding Failures and Windstorm Damage is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Chris Letchford, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (rpi.edu). This project seeks to utilize the NHERI-WoW facility at Florida International University to evaluate the Reynolds Number scalability of decades of fluid mechanics research on separated flows which have predominately been performed at low Reynolds Numbers, ie., low speed and small scale. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Pressure, Wind Speed. Published 2023-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
